defects.title: Coupon Validation Payload Schema Mismatch
defects.expected_behavior_vA: POST /api/coupons/apply with payload {'code': 'SAVE20'} validates coupon and applies 20% discount ($20.00 off).
defects.observed_behavior_vB: POST /api/coupons/apply fails with 422/400 Unprocessable Entity / Bad Request because backend expects 'couponCode' instead of 'code'.
defects.ground_truth_root_cause: Backend schema in v2 renamed required Pydantic model field from 'code' to 'couponCode' without backward compatibility or updating frontend request payload.
canonical_reproduction_steps: 2. Add product P101 to cart: POST /api/cart with {'product_id': 'P101', 'quantity': 1}
4. Observe 422/400 validation failure on Version B vs 200 OK on Version A

defects.title: Broken Navigation Target for Checkout Route
defects.expected_behavior_vA: Clicking 'Proceed to Checkout' button navigates to '/checkout.html' with HTTP status 200.
defects.observed_behavior_vB: Button href incorrectly points to '/checkout-v2.html', resulting in HTTP 404 Not Found error and blocking checkout.
defects.ground_truth_root_cause: Router link href attribute was modified to point to non-existent route '/checkout-v2.html'.
canonical_reproduction_steps: 2. Inspect 'Proceed to Checkout' anchor href in cart.html
3. Request the href URL: GET /checkout-v2.html returns 404 Not Found on Version B

defects.title: Cart Item Quantity State Hydration Bug
defects.expected_behavior_vA: Adding 3 units of product P101 renders item quantity as 'Qty: 3' in the cart interface.
defects.observed_behavior_vB: Cart interface renders item quantity hardcoded as 'Qty: 1' despite backend storing quantity = 3.
defects.ground_truth_root_cause: Client renderCart function in v2 hardcodes rendered string to 'Qty: 1' instead of reading item.quantity from state payload.
canonical_reproduction_steps: 2. Add 3 items of P101: POST /api/cart with {'product_id': 'P101', 'quantity': 3}
3. Check rendered cart HTML: Version B shows 'Qty: 1', Version A shows 'Qty: 3'

defects.title: Incorrect Tax Calculation Formula
defects.expected_behavior_vA: Tax is calculated as 10% of taxable subtotal ($100 subtotal -> $10.00 tax).
defects.observed_behavior_vB: Tax is calculated as $1.00 per item count ($100 single item -> $1.00 tax instead of $10.00).
defects.ground_truth_root_cause: Tax calculation formula in _calculate_cart_summary was changed from 'taxable_amount * 0.10' to 'float(item_count) * 1.0'.
canonical_reproduction_steps: 4. Version A tax_amount = $15.00; Version B tax_amount = $1.00

defects.title: Missing Form Accessibility Labels and Required Attributes
defects.expected_behavior_vA: Shipping inputs have explicit associated <label for='...'> tags and aria-required='true' / required attributes.
defects.observed_behavior_vB: Input fields have unassociated <span> tags and lack required / aria-required attributes.
defects.ground_truth_root_cause: Form template rewrite removed accessible label-for associations and HTML5 required attributes.
canonical_reproduction_steps: 2. Version A has <label for='customer-name'> and aria-required='true'; Version B has <span> and lacks aria-required

defects.title: Catalog Search Latency Regression
defects.observed_behavior_vB: GET /api/products?query=laptop executes blocking sleep, taking > 2000ms to respond.
defects.ground_truth_root_cause: Synchronous blocking delay loop introduced in query search endpoint handler.
canonical_reproduction_steps: 2. Version A latency < 100ms; Version B latency > 2000ms
